reuse.why: The new action reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages, sheetForMonth and the new shared category selection, and all bulk actions route through one exclusion predicate; the saved-template test is written locally rather than shared with goal-template code, which is acceptable.

duplication.why: The three copied hidden-category queries are collapsed into getBulkActionCategories and one isExcludedFromBulkActions predicate; only the categories/groups/notes join is spelled twice (getBudgetData and getBulkActionCategories) and the per-action income/tracking check stays repeated.

placement.why: Selection and exclusion live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; the DbViewCategoryWithGroupHidden type tweak and release notes are related, and the test additions are relevant.

maintainability.why: A new exclusion rule or flag is a one-line change in a single predicate used by every month-wide action; copyPreviousMonth applies it over a separate query, which is a small second path to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions call isExcludedFromBulkActions (directly or via getBulkActionCategories).

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repeated SQL join in getBudgetData and getBulkActionCategories is visible, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: isExcludedFromBulkActions/getBulkActionCategories gained only the includeHiddenCategories parameter the request asks for; every rule is part of the single predicate and no caller re-implements it.
